title: Semidefinite objective value
statement: Let $G$ be a weighted directed graph on the vertex set $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$, and assign a vector $U_v\\in\\mathbb{R}^n$ to each vertex. The semidefinite objective value of this assignment is $\\displaystyle \\sum_{v,w} w(v,w)\\,\\frac{1-\\langle U_v,U_w\\rangle}{2}$, where the sum ranges over all ordered pairs of vertices.
hypotheses_covered: A weighted directed graph on Fin n
A vector in EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) assigned to each vertex
